column1: # What each query must give in each variant (AUD-5, #389): <variant> <query> <expect> <note>, separated by tabs.
# .github/scripts/formal.py run compares the result of ProVerif with this file and fails on any difference, so a
# query that must hold and does not fails the job, and so does a negative control that stops showing its
# attack. A variant with no line for a query of its files, or a line for a query it has not, fails too.
#   attack   ProVerif finds an attack and rebuilds its trace: "is false"
#   fails    it is not proved: "is false" or "cannot be proved"
#   reach    the event can happen, so that the queries about it are not true for want of any run: "is false"
#            or "cannot be proved" of the query that asks for its absence
# note: the finding or the control, when the line is one (see docs/formal-model.md)
